f3_program: collection("openai.robotics_competition.robots", "robot", "openai.robotics_competition", source("a robotics competition that limits the weight of each robot"))
observe(at("openai.standard_robot.weight", "current"), 100, "pound", source("The standard robot weighs 100 pounds"))

offset(at("openai.robotics_competition.robots.minimum_allowed_weight", "current"), at("openai.standard_robot.weight", "current"), 5, "pound", source("no less than 5 pounds heavier than the standard robot"))

multiple(at("openai.robotics_competition.robots.maximum_allowed_weight", "current"), at("openai.robotics_competition.robots.minimum_allowed_weight", "current"), 2, source("no more than twice the minimum weight"))
query("value", at("openai.robotics_competition.robots.maximum_allowed_weight", "current"))
observe(at("robert.basic_salary", "last_month"), 1250, "dollar", source("a basic salary of $1250 per month"))
observe(at("robert.sales", "last_month"), 23600, "dollar", source("Last month, his total sales were $23600"))
percent_of(at("robert.commission", "last_month"), at("robert.sales", "last_month"), 10, source("10% commission on his monthly sales"))

sum_relation(at("robert.total_earnings", "last_month"), at("robert.basic_salary", "last_month"), at("robert.commission", "last_month"), source("earns a basic salary of $1250 per month and,  10% commission on his monthly sales"))
percent_of(at("robert.savings", "last_month"), at("robert.total_earnings", "last_month"), 20, source("20% of his total earnings to savings"))

difference_relation(at("robert.monthly_expenses", "last_month"), at("robert.total_earnings", "last_month"), at("robert.savings", "last_month"), source("the rest of the money to his monthly expenses"))
query("value", at("robert.monthly_expenses", "last_month"))
collection("kiddie_pool.water_contributions", "water_quantity", "kiddie_pool", source("Timmy, Tommy and Tina are filling up a kiddie pool in their backyard"))
multiple(at("timmy.pail.water_capacity", "current"), at("tommy.pail.water_capacity", "current"), 2, source("Timmy's pail holds twice as much water as Tommy's"))
offset(at("tommy.pail.water_capacity", "current"), at("tina.pail.water_capacity", "current"), 2, "gallon", source("Tommy's holds 2 gallons more than Tina's"))
observe(at("tina.pail.water_capacity", "current"), 4, "gallon", source("Tina's is 4 gallons"))

transfer("timmy_three_pool_trips", "timmy", at("house.water.volume", "current"), at("kiddie_pool.water.volume", "current"), scale(at("timmy.pail.water_capacity", "current"), 3), source("how much water do the three of them fill the pool with after 3 trips each"))

transfer("tommy_three_pool_trips", "tommy", at("house.water.volume", "current"), at("kiddie_pool.water.volume", "current"), scale(at("tommy.pail.water_capacity", "current"), 3), source("how much water do the three of them fill the pool with after 3 trips each"))

transfer("tina_three_pool_trips", "tina", at("house.water.volume", "current"), at("kiddie_pool.water.volume", "current"), scale(at("tina.pail.water_capacity", "current"), 3), source("how much water do the three of them fill the pool with after 3 trips each"))
member("kiddie_pool.water_contributions", event_field("timmy_three_pool_trips", "quantity"), source("the three of them fill the pool with after 3 trips each"))
member("kiddie_pool.water_contributions", event_field("tommy_three_pool_trips", "quantity"), source("the three of them fill the pool with after 3 trips each"))
member("kiddie_pool.water_contributions", event_field("tina_three_pool_trips", "quantity"), source("the three of them fill the pool with after 3 trips each"))
query("sum", "kiddie_pool.water_contributions", "after_3_trips_each")
observe(at("sgre.revenue", "2019"), 10227, "million_euro", cell("Revenue", "2019"))
observe(at("sgre.revenue", "2018"), 9122, "million_euro", cell("Revenue", "2018"))
query("difference", at("sgre.revenue", "2018"), at("sgre.revenue", "2019"))
collection("town_council.planted_cherry_trees", "cherry_tree", "neighborhood", source("planting cherry trees around the neighborhood"))
observe(at("town_council.cherry_trees.planned.count", "initial"), 7, "count", source("originally intended to plant 7 cherry trees"))

add("decade_cherry_tree_planting", "town_council", at("town_council.planted_cherry_trees.count", "current"), "town_council.planted_cherry_trees.added.count", source("By the end of the decade, they have planted twice as many cherry trees as they originally planned"))

multiple(event_field("decade_cherry_tree_planting", "quantity"), at("town_council.cherry_trees.planned.count", "initial"), 2, source("By the end of the decade, they have planted twice as many cherry trees as they originally planned"))
observe(at("town_council.planted_cherry_trees.leaves_dropped_per_tree", "fall"), 100, "leaf_per_tree", source("Each tree drops 100 leaves each during the fall"))

produce("fall_leaf_drop", "town_council.planted_cherry_trees", at("neighborhood.fallen_cherry_leaves.count", "current"), "neighborhood.fallen_cherry_leaves.produced.count", source("Each tree drops 100 leaves each during the fall"))

product_relation(event_field("fall_leaf_drop", "quantity"), event_field("decade_cherry_tree_planting", "quantity"), at("town_council.planted_cherry_trees.leaves_dropped_per_tree", "fall"), source("Each tree drops 100 leaves each during the fall"))
query("value", event_field("fall_leaf_drop", "quantity"))
